verses.text: Tato tz'ilchaj sniwanil junok anima t'a spatiktakel he chonhab' t'a lum lum ol yak' Jehová ko Diosal eyikej chi', manh chekelok mach ix mak'anchamok,
a heb' winh juez yet' heb' winh yichamtak winakil juntzanh chonhab' ay t'a slak'anil jun chamnak chi', a heb' tz'echtani mach junok juntzanh chonhab' chi' lak'an ay b'aj ix cham jun anima chi'.
Slajwi chi', haxo heb' winh yichamtak winakil chonhab' ay t'a slak'anil chi', a heb' winh tz'ik'anb'at junok nok' kob'es wakax manta b'aj tz'och te' yugo t'ay,
syik'anem nok' heb' winh t'a sch'olanil sti' junok ha' melem b'aj mantalaj mach smunlaji. Hata' smak'ji kanhchaj sjaj nok' wakax chi'.

Haxo heb' sacerdote yinhtilal Leví tz'och testigoal t'ay, yujto anhej heb' sb'oan yaj owal yet' tastak chukal tzuji t'a skal he chonhab', haton heb' sik'b'ilel yuj Jehová ko Diosal, ayoch heb' yak'an serwil yet' yalan wach' lolonel t'a Jehová chi'.
Slajwi chi', masanil heb' yichamtak winakil chonhab' chi' sb'ikel sk'ab' heb' t'a yib'anh nok' kob'es wakax chamnakxo chi',
syalan juntzanh lolonel heb' icha tik: Ha onh tik, manhok onh ix ko mak'cham jun anima tik, manh kojtakok mach ix mak'anchamok.
Mamin Jehová, ak' niwank'olal t'a kib'anh, mokab' ak'kanoch schamel jun anima tik ko mulok a onh a chonhab' onh kolb'il onh tik uuj, xcham heb'. Icha chi' tz'aj sb'o yaj schamel jun chamnak chi'.
Tato icha chi' sk'ulej heb', manhxalaj yalan yik heb' t'a jun chamnak chi', yujto ix sk'anab'ajej heb' tas syal Jehová.
Ayik tzeyak'an owal yet' heb' ajk'ool, tato tzeyak' ganar heb' yuj Jehová ko Diosal, tzeyik'ankot heb' he chekab'ok.
Tato ay mach t'a he kal tz'ilanoch junok ix ix te wach' yilji t'a skal heb', skan snib'ej t'a ix, syik'anb'at ix t'a spat,
hata' sjoxel xil sjolom ix, syik'anel yech ix,
sk'exchajel spichul ix ayochi ayik ix ik'jikot ix chi', skannhej ix t'a spat winh winak chi'. Jun ujal tz'ok' ix yuj smam snun. Slajwi chi', syik'an ix winh yetb'eyumok.
Tato slajwi chi', manhxa snib'ej winh t'a ix, syal yak'anel ix winh t'a libre. Palta max yal-laj schonhjiel ix, ma yoch ix schekab'ok winh, yujto toxo ix ixtaj ix yuj winh.
K'inalok ay junok winh winak chawanh yetb'eyum, jun ix te xajan yuj winh, haxo junxo ix chakb'ilel yuj winh. Tato tz'alji yune' heb' ix schawanhil, tato a jun ix chakb'ilel chi' sb'ab'laj alji yune',

ayik sk'och sk'ual spojanek' stastak winh, syak'an winh t'a heb' yuninal, max yal-laj yoch yune' ix xajanab'il chi' b'ab'el uninal. K'inalok icha b'ab'el unin syutej winh, chuk sk'ulej winh t'a winh sb'ab'el unin yik ix chakb'ilel chi', yujto a winh chi' yel b'ab'el unin yaj winh.
Yowalil a winh chi' b'ab'el unin yaji. Ha winh schaan cha makan smakb'en yik sb'ab'el uninab'il.
Tato ay mach ay junok yuninal te chuk, ma te pit, max sk'anab'ajej tas syal smam snun, wach'chom smak'ji, palta hanheja' max sk'anab'ajej.
Tato icha chi', a heb' mamab'il nunab'il chi', yowalil syik'b'at jun yune' heb' chi' t'a yichanh heb' winh yichamtak winakil chonhab',
syalan heb' icha tik: Ha wal jun kune' tik, te pit, te chuk. Max onh sk'anab'ajej, haxonhej chukal sk'ulej, te b'uk'tzin, anhej uk'el anh syak'a', xcham heb'.

Tato icha chi', haxo masanil heb' winh winak t'a jun chonhab' chi' sjulk'enancham jun yune' heb' chi'. Icha chi' tz'aj yik'jiel jantak chukal ay t'a yol he chonhab' chi'. Ayik syab'an jun chi' heb' ketchonhab' smasanil, sxiwk'e heb'.
Tato ay junok winak smak'jicham yuj schukal, sk'e lokan t'a junok te te',

a sniwanil chi', max kanlaj ta' tzek' ak'wal, yowalil smukchaj t'a jun k'u chi', yik wach' max eyixtejb'at lum lum ol yak' Jehová ko Diosal chi' t'ayex, yujto aykot skatab' Dios t'a yib'anh mach sk'e lokan t'a junok te te' chi'.
